Happy Hours by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Step into a world of fun, relaxation, and unforgettable memories at this stunning and spacious home, ideal for large family gatherings and business retreats. Nestled in the heart of iconic Blue Mountain Beach, “Happy Hours” is a one-of-a-kind retreat just a hop, skip, and a jump from the beach, local shops, and charming eateries. Enjoy the soft, sugar-white sands, explore nearby state parks, and indulge in some of 30A’s best dining—all just steps from your door. Located just two blocks from the Blue Mountain public beach access, this home offers convenient beach days with four private parking spaces off County Highway 83, plus additional parking via the alley. This unique four-story main home—plus a two-story carriage house—was thoughtfully designed for groups or multiple families. There’s plenty of space to gather, play, and entertain, with a layout that also offers privacy when you need it. Main House First Floor Garage (not accessible to guests). Second Floor Accessible via stairs on the south side of the home, this floor features: -A primary bedroom with a king bed -A guest room with two queen beds -A shared hallway bathroom—perfect for families vacationing together Third Floor The heart of the home! -Indoor and outdoor entertaining spaces -Screened-in patio and open-air deck off the kitchen -Gorgeous kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas range, walk-in pantry, and wine cooler -Primary king suite with a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower -Direct access to the private pool Fourth Floor -Two guest bedrooms (both kings) connected by a Jack-and-Jill bathroom -Additional living area with a TV and queen sleeper sofa Carriage House -A private escape all its own—perfect for in-laws, teens, or couples traveling together. -Separate parking and entrance -Private balcony with stunning views from the second floor overlooking the pool and ocean Carriage House First Floor -King bedroom with bunk beds -Living area with sleeper sofa -Spacious bathroom with walk-in shower Carriage House Second Floor -King bedroom -Full kitchen and living space -Private bathroom Designed for comfort and connection, this beachside haven offers something for everyone—whether you're gathering with family or enjoying a business retreat. Come unwind at Happy Hours and make memories to last a lifetime. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional.

We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: (Main and Carriage House) - .3 of a mile to Blue Mountain Beach Access - 7 bedrooms, 6 baths - 4191 sq ft - Wi-Fi - EV charging station - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Outdoor shower - 4 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: Main House 2nd Floor - 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom Guest room 1 - King bed Guest room 2 - 2 Queen beds (TV in room) Shared hallway bathroom 3rd Floor - 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms Guest room 3 - King bedroom with en suite bathroom (TV in room) 1 full hallway bathroom 4th Floor - 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom Guest room 4 - King bedroom with Jack and Jill bath Guest room 5 - King bedroom with shared bath Additional sleeper sofa, queen, in living area (TV in living area) Carriage House 1st Floor - 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom Guest room 6 - King bedroom with twin bunk beds Living room with sleeper sofa, queen, TV and bathroom 2nd Floor - 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom Guest room 7 - King bedroom Living room with sleeper sofa, queen, kitchenette, TV and bathroom Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
